node_01_bg: Outskirts of the city, a rainy night, an old broadcast studio building. Rain drips down the sign, a flickering neon reads "Starlight Broadcasting".
node_03_pl: I came here after seeing a recruitment ad, but this place looks completely on the verge of bankruptcy...
node_05_bg: Inside the building, a dusty reception desk, a dim and dark hallway.
node_07_ld: (From inside) Oh my, you're finally here!
node_08_bg: Inside the office, stacks of documents fill the desk, and a woman in her 50s sitting in a chair smiles gently.
node_09_ld: I am the former owner of this broadcasting station.
node_10_ld: From now on, this station is yours.
node_11_pl: Wait a moment... I just came here to apply for a job?
node_12_ld: (Smiling) Is that so? But I really took a liking to you.
node_13_ld: Instead of a monthly salary... I'll give you this broadcasting station.
node_15_bg: Old broadcasting equipment, cameras, lighting, and posters on the wall... all featuring sensual and provocative women.
node_16_ld: (Lighting a cigarette) This broadcasting station... isn't an ordinary one.
node_17_ld: It's an adult broadcasting station. That's why all the employees ran away.
node_18_ld: However... this is where the real money is nowadays. You know that too, don't you?
node_20_bg: On the computer screen, provocative thumbnails of past live streams are displayed.
node_21_ld: (Handing over documents) Don't worry. There's no one here right now, but...
node_22_ld: You can scout and bring in creators yourself. You know about scouting, right?
node_23_ld: All you have to do... is create an environment where they can broadcast comfortably.
node_25_pl: (Hesitating a moment) ...I'll give it a try.
node_26_bg: As the contract is signed, a heavy red official stamp is pressed onto the paper.
node_27_ld: (Standing up) You made a wise choice, CEO.
node_28_ld: Now that you've taken over the station... there's only one thing left to do.
node_29_ld: Go out and start searching for creators.
node_30_bg: After the former owner departs, faint dawn light begins to seep through the window of the quiet, solitary office.
node_32_pl: (Turning on the computer) Anyway... I guess I really am the boss now.
node_33_pl: (Determined) Alright. Let's find some creators first.
node_34_pl: Time to head out for scouting.
